title: lathyrus bolanderi var. tracyi
intro: Lathyrus bolanderi var. tracyi, commonly known as Bolander's sweet pea or Tracy's sweet pea, is a variety of flowering plant in the pea family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, and has been traditionally used to treat various ailments such as digestive issues and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Lathyrus bolanderi var. tracyi include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic effects, making it a potential remedy for pain relief and muscle relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isoflavones, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
